label: Bible Study
prompt: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is _____.
verse: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
note: Written from chains — Paul sees a win either way, living or dying.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the _____ of the Almighty.
verse: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
note: The 'secret place' psalm — dwell close enough to the Almighty and you end up living in His shade.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And at _____ Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.
verse: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.
note: Beaten and locked in stocks, Paul and Silas held a midnight hymn sing — and the other prisoners were listening.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish _____; but unto us which are saved it is the power of God.
verse: For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish foolishness; but unto us which are saved it is the power of God.
note: To Greek philosophers a crucified Savior sounded absurd — Paul agrees it looks foolish, and calls it power anyway.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Looking unto Jesus the author and _____ of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
verse: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
note: Jesus is 'the author and finisher' of faith — the one who starts it is the one who completes it.
